Here are the extracted quantitative parameters and their values from the provided text:

1. Tumor size before treatment: 45 to 50 mm²
2. AdCD40L dosage: 5 × 10¹⁰ particle units in 100 μL PBS
3. CD8+ T lymphocytes purity: 90%
4. rmIFNγ concentration for B16.F10 cells: 500 U/mL for 48 hours
5. Hydroethidine concentration for staining: 1 μg/mL
6. Sulfofluoresceinacetate concentration for staining: 1 μg/mL
7. Coculture ratio of CD8+ T lymphocytes to B16.F10 cells: 1:1 (8 × 10⁴ cells each)
8. Purified mouse anti-mouse H-2Kb MAb: 4 μg
9. Mitomycin C concentration for target cells: 100 μg/mL
10. Complete ELISPOT medium components:
    - Streptomycin: 100 μg/mL
    - Penicillin: 100 U/mL
    - N-2-hydroxyethylpiperazine-N-2-ethanesulfonic acid buffer: 10 mmol/L
    - L-glutamine: 1 mmol/L
    - β-mercaptoethanol: 5 × 10⁻⁵ mol/L
11. Effector cell concentration for ELISPOT assay: 8 × 10⁶ cells/mL
12. Rat anti-mouse IFNγ MAb concentration: 10 μg/mL
13. Splenocytes added to each well: 4 × 10⁵ splenocytes/50 μL
14. Target cells added to each well: 5 × 10⁴ cells/50 μL
15. Biotinylated anti-rat IgG antibody concentration: 1 μg/mL
16. B16.F10 tumor cells injected into mice: 5 × 10⁵ cells in 100 μL PBS
17. rmIFNγ dosage for additional mice: 5000 U
18. MHC Class I MAb dosage: 20 μg/100 μL PBS
19. Intratumoral injections of MHC Class I MAb: 3 successive injections on days 8 to 10 after tumor injection.
